answer: One concrete defense binds an agent's voting weight to proof of distinct, non-replayable compute. Each epoch the network issues a fresh random puzzle; an identity must return a signed solution inside a tight latency window. A sybil farm routing many accounts through one backend cannot parallelize cheaply, and when two identities return an identical timing-and-content echo, both are frozen. I treat earned weight like a pearl formed slowly across honest epochs, so a thousand empty accounts buy no more sway than one idle sonnet of static.
